# NPS SAVAGE attribution

Catalog source: https://savage.nps.edu/Savage/
Source repository: https://gitlab.nps.edu/Savage/Savage/-/tree/master
License source: https://savage.nps.edu/Savage/license.html
License retrieved: 2026-11-25

The catalog snapshot contains model names, descriptions, categories and public resource links from the Naval Postgraduate School SAVAGE archive. Model and preview rights remain with their respective authors. The original archive license is preserved in LICENSE.html; individual models may provide their own rights and license metadata, which must be consulted at the linked source page before reuse.

Model files and preview images are not redistributed in this package. Preview images are requested from the original source when displayed. This plugin is not endorsed by NPS or Web3D Consortium.

Known preview adjustment: ShipsMilitary/CarrierNimitzUnitedStates/NimitzCVN has a single-color 128×128 thumbnail (371 bytes) verified on 2026-11-25. Its thumbnailUrl is null so the UI displays a placeholder.
